description: Whether a combination of country, record type and US state is covered, with the canonical names and a link to that search on the site. Use it for "do you have realtors in Texas" or "brokerage offices in Florida". Limitation: says covered or not; the number of matching records and the records themselves are shown on the site, not here.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. United States or US

industry.description: Record type, e.g. real estate agent or brokerage office

us_state.description: US state name or code; only with country US

name: check_coverage
title: Check a filter combination
